exec_summary: A self-learning X-ray diffraction agent turns analytical experience into validated skills, with strong results across several identification tasks.
AtomWorld-Mirror reports 1,000–10,000x faster long-horizon materials simulation across five atomic systems.
GPT-6 adds interactive UI while Google Playground makes prompt-generated games shareable.
Creators show voice-first language tutoring, visualizations, AI video, and coding-agent workflows in finished demos.
Community builders put agents on a feature phone, in a screen-annotation tool, and inside personal-productivity projects.
